AC amendment (gap-analysis): manifest cross-check — pin the probed manifest path to the exact fd41 path 'plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml' as a single named constant, and test BOTH degrade branches.
  Verify (manifest-absent degrade -> presence-only pass): ensured by AC #8 (real corpus passes with no manifest in-tree).
  Verify (manifest-present enforcing branch rejects unknown harness id): T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/man.XXXXXX") && printf 'harnesses:\n  - id: only-engine.sh\n' > "$T" && grep -q 'plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml' tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py && echo OK  (the manifest-present unknown-id rejection is exercised by test-corpus-schema.sh using a synthesized temp manifest + a corpus entry referencing an unknown harness id, asserting non-zero).
